Author: Chief Justice Bench: Chief Justice  1  IN THE HIGH COURT OF MADHYA PRADESH  AT JABALPUR  CRA No. 4576 of 2022  (SUSHIL Vs THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH AND OTHERS)
Dated : 18-08-2023  Shri Pradeep Singh Chouhan - Advocate for appellant.
 Shri Pramod Thakre - Public Prosecutor for the State.
 Heard on I.A. No.18751 of 2022.

entities.label: COURT

entities.text: STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH AND OTHERS
entities.label: RESPONDENT

sentences.text: This is an application filed by the accused seeking for suspension of sentence and grant of bail.

The appellant has been convicted under Sections 376(3) and 307 of the I.P.C. and Section 5(r)/6 of the POCSO Act and sentenced to R.I. for Life and fine of Rs.5,000/-, R.I. for Life and fine of Rs.5,000/- and R.I. for Life and fine of Rs.5,000/- respectively with default stipulations.
The case of the prosecution is that on 18.01.2021 in between 17:30 hours to 18:15 hours the accused caught hold of the minor girl belonging to Scheduled Caste community and committed offences on her.

Based on the information furnished by the sister of victim, Crime No.43 of 2021 was registered against the accused for the offence punishable under Sections 376(3),
323, 324 of the I.P.C., Section 3/4 of the POCSO Act and Sections 3(1)(w)(i)
and 3(2)(va) of the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act.

entities.text: Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: After completing the investigation, charge sheet was filed.
On trial, the accused has been convicted and sentenced as mentioned above.
Learned counsel for the appellant contends that the accused is innocent of the offence.
That the prosecution has failed to make out any case against him.
That there is no evidence to implicate the accused.
Hence, the accused be enlarged on bail.
The same is disputed by the learned Public Prosecutor  2  appearing for the State.
On hearing learned counsels, we find no good ground to enlarge th  appellant on bail.
The victim is aged 14 years.
The doctor has opined that she  has suffered as many as 20 injuries.
She belongs to the scheduled caste  community.
There is sufficient material led by the prosecution that has proved  the guilt of the accused.
Hence, we find absolutely no ground to enlarge the  accused on bail.
I.A. No.18751 of 2022 is accordingly dismissed.

(RAVI MALIMATH) (VISHAL MISHRA)
